EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hey! How about a game of

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿Quieres jugar al escondite?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Que sepas que soy la mejor
del pueblo, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
¡Soy toda una experta en
esconderme de los fans pesados
y los periodistas entrometidos!{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
¡Juguemos!
No, gracias

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ehi! Non sarebbe davvero spaziale

bravo di me, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Certo, giochiamo!
No, grazie.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hey! Wie wär's mit 'ner Runde
Verstecken? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Niemand versteckt
sich so gut wie ich, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Ja, gerne!
Nö, danke.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hey! Bir el saklambaç oynamaya
ne dersin? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Saklanmakta benden iyisi
yoktur, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Olur, oynayalım!
Yok, sağ ol.
